name: gold-digger
description: GoldDigger is an interactive web application and investment simulator that visualizes the process of buying 24 Carat Gold. The app displays fluctuating, near-real-time gold prices per troy ounce in GBP (£), simulates network connection states (Connected/Disconnected), and allows users to input any investment amount for an instant mock purchase.
